ValidationRule.description: Remark is mandatory when REC Status set to Inactive, Duplicate and Blacklist
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(IF(OR( ISPICKVAL( EYI_REC_Status__c , 'Inactive'),ISPICKVAL( EYI_REC_Status__c , 'Duplicate'),ISPICKVAL( EYI_REC_Status__c , 'Frozen') ) , ISBLANK( EYI_Rejection_Remark__c) , null),EYI_IsAutomationBypassed__c = false)
